data.name: OIL & HORROR
data.detailed_description:
Strike it rich… or freeze to death trying.

You are an oil prospector in one of the most hostile places on Earth: a frozen, monster-infested Arctic wasteland. Oil lies somewhere beneath the ice. The only way to find it is to gamble everything—your money, your fuel, and your life.

Choose a sector and start drilling. Every depth level costs you hard cash and precious fuel. Keep pushing in the hope of a gusher… or cut your losses and abandon the hole before it bankrupts you. Dry holes will break you. One lucky strike can make you a millionaire. - But the ice is not empty.

Ice spikes erupt without warning. Clouds of lethal spores drift from alien bugs. And the real threats are hunting you: massive mutant slugs, the Dedites, giant mutant spiders, undead razorback boars, huge rotting polar bears… and a Warlok determined to wipe you off the face of the Earth. Random attacks can end a run in seconds.

Your machine gun is your best friend out here. Keep it loaded, keep it firing, and stay sharp. When the pressure mounts, buy grenades and watch enemies explode into a thousand pieces. One-hit kills never get old.

Green mushrooms restore your health. Red ones will poison you. Keep your eyes open for scattered caches of health, ammo and fuel—grab them when you can, because the next attack is never far away.

This is high-stakes oil prospecting turned into a brutal survival strategy game. Every decision matters. Every depth level drilled is a calculated risk. Survive long enough, strike enough oil, and you can walk away with millions—and a place on the global Steam leaderboard.

High risk. High reward.

data.short_description: A high-risk high-reward oil prospecting survival game. Strategically choose a sector and depth to drill. Strike oil or abandon the hole. Survive ice spikes, spores, mutant monsters and a vengeful Warlok. Defend yourself with your trusty machine gun and grenade launcher, and strike it rich!

content_descriptors.notes:
The main character has a cigar in his mouth as part of his character trait.
The game visuals are in no way realistic. The game graphics are a very cartoon-like 8-bit style. There are a lot of 8-bit style pixel particle explosions to denote blood loss due to being shot by bullets or grenades in game.
